body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Iteratively redesigns a technology for performance, cost, and manufacturability. (Proposed capability.) A technology evolution engine would loop design-simulate-test cycles autonomously, improving a product generation over generation. Narrow versions exist (evolutionary antenna design, AutoML); a general engine is simulated in limited domains. Status: simulated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
